title: Oath of the Paladin Hypnosis
description:
You, brave adventurer, have arrived at the shrine of the Goddess. Now, you may relax. Relax and learn what you could be, if you only accept that you worship the Goddess. The Goddess Calia.

This file is about abstaining from something to show your faith in Goddess. A sactifice. A commitment, an oath that shows you are able to be someone dedicated and worshipful, obedient and mindful. Good. A paladin. Just 24 hours without something of your choosing. What shall it be?

All you must do, is choose. Take the ritual, and speak the oath. To show that you belong to her now.

Art by Judith Blue_Orchid
author: Mistress Calia
